card.name: Decimal point in p-values after zero
card.fires_on: The decimal point right after "p=0" (or the digit after it) in reported p-values, usually next to hazard ratios and confidence intervals in trial results.

modes.label: Decimal point in p-value
modes.description: The period after the 0 in p=0 or p = 0 inside a results parenthesis with HR and CI.
